words.definition: The system of production, distribution, and exchange of goods and services
words.definationTranslation: उत्पादन, वितरण और सेवाओं के विनिमय की प्रणाली

sentence.sentence: The global economy is facing a severe crisis.
sentence.translation: वैश्विक अर्थव्यवस्था एक गंभीर संकट का सामना कर रही है।

sentence.sentence: The economy of a country depends on various factors.
sentence.translation: किसी देश की अर्थव्यवस्था विभिन्न कारकों पर निर्भर करती है।

words.definition: The exchange of goods or services between countries or organizations
words.definationTranslation: देशों या संगठनों के बीच वस्तुओं या सेवाओं का आदान-प्रदान

sentence.sentence: The country's trade deficit is a major concern.

words.definition: The act of putting money into something in order to earn a profit

sentence.sentence: The company is planning to make a significant investment in the new project.

words.definition: A place where buyers and sellers interact to exchange goods or services

sentence.sentence: The global market is becoming increasingly competitive.

sentence.sentence: The company is trying to expand its market share.
sentence.translation: कंपनी अपने बाजार हिस्सेदारी को बढ़ाने की कोशिश कर रही है।

words.definition: An increase in size, amount, or degree

words.definition: A sustained increase in the general price level of goods and services

words.definition: The state of being without a job or occupation

sentence.translation: सरकार रोजगार सृजन कार्यक्रमों के माध्यम से बेरोजगारी को कम करने की कोशिश कर रही है।

words.definition: Relating to government revenue or expenditure

words.definition: Relating to money or currency

words.definition: Able to be maintained or supported without depleting natural resources

sentence.sentence: The company is committed to sustainable development.

sentence.sentence: Sustainable practices are essential for environmental protection.

words.definition: The process of growth or improvement

sentence.sentence: The company is focused on sustainable development.

words.definition: The state of being extremely poor

words.definition: The state of being unequal or uneven

sentence.sentence: The company is working to reduce inequality in the workplace.
sentence.translation: कंपनी कार्यस्थल में असमानता को कम करने के लिए काम कर रही है।

words.definition: A large business or organization

sentence.sentence: The company is a multinational corporation with operations in several countries.
sentence.translation: कंपनी एक बहुराष्ट्रीय निगम है जिसके कई देशों में कार्य हैं।

words.definition: A person who starts and runs their own business
words.definationTranslation: एक व्यक्ति जो अपना खुद का व्यवसाय शुरू करता है और चलाता है

sentence.translation: कंपनी एक सफल उद्यमी द्वारा स्थापित की गई थी।

sentence.translation: सूक्ष्म वित्त ने कई विकासशील देशों में गरीबी को कम करने में मदद की है।

words.definition: Relating to money or finance

words.definition: A group of companies or organizations that produce similar goods or services
words.definationTranslation: समान वस्तुओं या सेवाओं का उत्पादन करने वाली कंपनियों या संगठनों का समूह

sentence.sentence: The company is a leader in the technology industry.
sentence.translation: कंपनी प्रौद्योगिकी उद्योग में एक नेता है।

words.definition: The basic systems and structures that a country or organization needs to function

sentence.sentence: The country is investing heavily in its infrastructure.
sentence.translation: देश अपनी अवसंरचना में भारी निवेश कर रहा है।
